scientific_integrity: The all-n proof is structural and independent of the finite verifier. Exhaustive deletion-subset checks cover n=3,4,5, with algebraic coefficient checks through n=12. Search absence is not treated as proof of novelty; residual terminology/indexing risk is retained.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary edge-bondage for crown graphs with n at least 3. The 1990 foundational article was available only through bibliographic metadata/abstract-level evidence in the inspected lawful sources; the fully searchable 2013 survey was inspected and contained no crown-graph formula. The exact-day metadata date is the verified first-publication date of that survey, not an invented day for the 1990 paper.
title: Bondage edge-set enumerator of crown graphs
